detail.longDescription:
Half the things I self-host, a free hosted service would do better and I know it. I still run my own. Not for privacy or principle really, more that the hosted version never feels like mine.

It's a worse tool I understand completely, against a better one I'm just renting a view into.

I can't defend it on any spreadsheet. I'd do it again tomorrow.

What do you self-host that makes no rational sense?

#selfhosted
